info.name: Search for profiles by verified account username

params.name: username
params.description: The username used on the verified third-party service.

params.name: service
params.description: The service to limit search to (e.g., 'github', 'twitter'). See `/verified-accounts/services` for supported IDs.

params.name: page
params.description: Page number of results to retrieve.

params.name: per_page
params.description: Number of results per page. Defaults to 20, maximum 50.

items.docs: Searches Gravatar profiles that have a verified account with the given username. Optionally filter by the service (e.g., 'github', 'twitter'). See `/verified-accounts/services` for supported ID values. Results are paginated.

info.name: Get list of services supported as verified accounts

items.docs: Returns the list of verified account services with their ID and human-readable labels.
